newsitem.title: CHINA: China Guomai sets expanded pager network.
newsitem.headline: China Guomai sets expanded pager network.

text.p: The Shanghai Guomai Communications Co Ltd said on Friday it has begun operating an international paging network.
"We started the international pager service in late June," said a company official, speaking by telephone from Shanghai.

The company has about 900,000 pager customers. Its international paging service covers more than 20 countries in North America, South America, Europe and Asia, the official said without giving further details.
In the first six months of this year, the number of pager users in China reached 30 million, up 5.0 million from the end of last year, state media have said.
